details:
Avatar expression parameters containing Japanese characters in their names appear to fail to synchronize with remote players when the avatar is uploaded using SDK 3.11.0-beta.1.

Environment

VRChat SDK: 3.11.0-beta.1

Affected feature: Avatar Expression Parameters synchronization

Affected characters: Japanese / non-ASCII characters

Steps to Reproduce

1.Create an avatar using SDK 3.11.0-beta.1.

2.Add the following Bool parameters to the Expression Parameters asset:

Test

テスト

衣装

Test_衣装

3.Enable network synchronization for all parameters.

4.Create Expression Menu toggles and corresponding Animator transitions for each parameter.

5.Upload the avatar to VRChat.

6.Join an instance with another player.

7.Toggle each parameter and compare the local and remote avatar states.

Expected Behavior

All network-synchronized parameters should synchronize correctly with remote players, regardless of whether their names contain ASCII or Japanese characters.

Actual Behavior

Parameters containing Japanese characters in their names appear to fail to synchronize with remote players.
title: [SDK 3.11.0-beta.1] Avatar parameters with Japanese names may fail to synchronize
